runtimeMapping.trait: One retained primary at full ATK, independent 50% ATK ground splash inside the original 1.0 circle at the native attack event. S3 retains other blocked victims outside the circle.
runtimeMapping.talents: ON_SKILL_START/ON_TARGET_KILLED counts own kills, ON_BUFF_FINISH grants capped forced SP. E2 global CHARACTER/WARRIOR aura is an additive ATK percentage, including self and late deployments.
runtimeMapping.skill1: AUTO next-attack skill with source charges and a conditional manual cleanse permit. Native flag34 is interpreted as force-skill activation; only native resistable buffs are cleared. Input death returns the charge. SP stays locked through the complete original Skill_1 animation tail.
runtimeMapping.skill2: Fixed Begin/End animations; source 2-5 range, random primary, ATK and ASPD. Only completed startup commits the use count; extra ASPD increases on the second/third activations, caps at two stacks and resets on redeployment.
runtimeMapping.skill3: Source +0.2s interval, four post-attack additive ATK/radius stacks, separate primary/splash stuns, ground splash plus other own blocked victims. Native max-stack hook changes Loop_A to Loop_B. Inactive ON_TAKE_DAMAGE grants one SP through the E2 talent sp blackboard.
runtimeMapping.animation: Original .833 Attack/Skill_1, .167 Skill_2_Loop, 1.167 Skill_3_Loop_A/B events with uncapped interval-derived playback, including BAT changes. Both exact official facing skeleton chains matched the pinned public SD bytes.

verificationLimits: Modules, native Unity particles and audio are not enabled. Original effects and references are retained as evidence, not rendered substitutes.
The shared tick scheduler, fixed skill startup/handoff clocks, source attack-rate mapping and complete S1 tail are locally tested; no native frame comparison has certified those dispatch details.

Native S3 main-target buff dispatch order relative to same-event secondary damage is not executed by a native engine here. The runtime applies the source description post-attack ATK/radius growth after the complete hit group.

Flag34 force-cast and AUTO resistability use the reviewed native mask semantics shared with Lessing. Broader statuses marked sourceStatusResistable true can be cleansed; controls explicitly marked false remain. Arbitrary Unity status combinations are not certified.
S3 implicit sp blackboard resolution uses the available E2 talent sp=1. Native C# blackboard lookup internals are not available for an independent runtime comparison.
Random S2 selection includes legal own blocked targets and samples once for the retained primary. Native random-generator/ordering parity is not claimed.
The playable stage still contains only two basic enemies. Synthetic aerial, control, resistance and immunity tests do not enable other enemy types or certify their mechanics.
